blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (творческие люди) творят, нетворческие - плагиатят, все остальные - переводят.
exercises.prompt: Creative people create, the non-creative plagiarize, all the others - translate.
exercises.why: The only rules that are used in the nominative case are those to turn a word into its plural form (each case has its own rules for converting a word into the singular of that case, and into that case's plural form). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 16.  ·  «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16.
exercises.context: The only rules that are used in the nominative case are those to turn a word into its plural form (each case has its own rules for converting a word into the singular of that case, and into that case's plural form).
